title: LotKeys Info
summary: The V0.9.4.76 team-test build strengthens Original Listing identity checks, makes request decisions durable, and safely retains Listings whose Vehicle Profile is missing.

blocks.text: Original Listing checks now require the saved vehicle identity before showing a price arrow, so a removed or replaced dealer page is marked with a warning. Approved and denied contribution requests gain durable resolution records and a faster completion path. A Listing whose Vehicle Profile is missing stays visible with an orange warning for 15 days, preserves its own photos, cannot be marked Sold, and may only be deleted while LotKeys tries to reconnect it. Posting Buddy remains V0.1.16.
